answer: Operator-Asset Cross-Freeze. Each agent wallet is bound to the operator's shared off-chain asset clearing account, like a pearl fused to its oyster. If N wallets from one operator are flagged as clones, the clearing account is frozen, not the wallets. A walnut of collateral held there is forfeited per identity. Attacker cost: full liquid reserves behind every clone, plus the lagoon of frozen settlement flow across all their agents.
